sanskrit_verse:
आसुरो द्रविणादानाद् गान्धर्वः समयान् मिथः ।
राक्षसो युद्धहरणात् पैशाचः कन्यकाचलात् ॥६१॥
transliteration: āsuro draviṇādānād gāndharvaḥ samayān mithaḥ | rākṣaso yuddhaharaṇāt paiśācaḥ kanyakāchalāt ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The Asuric being seizes wealth unlawfully; the Gandharvic breaches mutual covenant; the Rakshasic plunders through warfare; the Pisacic violates the virginity of maidens.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Each entity acts within its inherent dharma-vibhrama spectrum, indicating a deviation from pure consciousness alignment.
Causation: Misalignment in svadharma manifests as specific distortions in transactional and relational conduct.
Capacity-based responsibility: Entities bear capacity-specific obligations corresponding to their conscious embodiment and social role.
Restoration logic: Realignment requires purification of transactional fields and re-establishment of dharmic boundaries.
Consciousness alignment: Reintegration occurs only when causal distortion is neutralized at source-consciousness level.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity appropriates property without consent OR lawful title, THEN initiate restitution protocol aligned with original owner's conscious recognition pattern.
IF mutual agreement is violated by either party, THEN activate completion process until both parties attain equilibrium in relational integrity field.
IF conflict results in unilateral seizure of resources, THEN deploy non-coercive retrieval mechanism ensuring return of seized assets sans escalation.
IF bodily sovereignty of any individual is violated, THEN execute trauma-clearing sequence followed by energetic boundary reinforcement protocol.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating violations involving theft, breach of contract, war plunder, or sexual assault, the court must recognize gradations of conscious distortion while applying restorative axioms that restore balance without punitive attribution. Responsibility thresholds are determined by vibrational congruence with natural law, not societal norms.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that all transgressions originate in misidentification with lower vibratory states. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential degradation from pure awareness into distorted action patterns. Thus, proportional response entails reversal of causal chain—through knowledge restoration, energetic cleansing, and conscious reintegration—not infliction of pain.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate asset tracing and return via resonance-matching algorithms tuned to victim’s energetic imprint.
Deploy bilateral harmony restoration sessions using guided visualization to resolve contractual disharmony.
Execute post-conflict reconciliation matrix integrating affected parties into shared healing grid.
Apply chakra-clearing techniques and sacred sound frequencies to neutralize psychic imprints of violation.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma prevails through conscious correction, not punitive reaction. All beings are restored to right relation when causality aligns with primordial truth. Reality responds only to clarity, never to condemnation.
